The target video uses a clean, lightly comedic Chinese-sitcom style with bright classroom lighting and a steady, conversational pace.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to a medium close-up of <Subject 2> (S2). He scratches the back of his head, hands behind his back, deadpan and a little nervous, and replies in a flat drawl, <d>[Chinese] 路上扶老奶奶过马路了！</d>
